title: Transcriber's Note Wording: Endnotes in a Separate Volume

illustrates.quote: Extensive endnote sections may be placed in a separate volume. This transposition of endnotes must be mentioned on the Transcriber’s Notes page in each volume. Sample:

blocks.text: The endnotes to the text are in a separate volume.
blocks.features: Set in italics, indented as a sample of suggested wording for the Transcriber's Notes page, per rule 16.9.2c.

print.surroundingText: Follows rule 16.9.2c directly; immediately precedes Example 16-13: Extensive Notes in a Separate Volume (Print Only).
print.printFeatures: Plain indented italic sentence, no box, no accompanying braille rendering shown in the source.

braille.notes: No braille rendering of this sentence is given in the source; it is suggested wording only. None is guessed here.

uncertain: This item is a plain-text 'Sample:' of suggested wording; braille.lines is left empty rather than inferring a transcription.
resolution: illustrates.rule set to 16.9.2.c per standards-map.md's own BANA §16/B004 §11 worked-examples table (the project's established canonical id), not either run's own guess. print.blocks/print.notes follow Run B's schema ([ref:MARK] tokens inline + a separate print.notes[] array of {ref, placement, text}), matching this task's required schema; Run A instead folded each note's real content directly into a sibling print.blocks entry with no [ref:MARK] markers and always an empty print.notes[] -- a schema-level difference, not a content disagreement. braille.width: print-only per standards-map.md; both runs agree. braille.lines: the two runs agreed byte-for-byte; kept as transcribed.
